channel.title: Operation Ouch!
channel.desc: The Doctors hit the road in the Ouch Taxi to surprise the winners of the third Ouch! Awards. Find out how Dr Chris and Dr Xand do as they join the four inspirational heroes for their prize day treats - from tank driving to sailing, and go karting to Afrobeats dancing, they have their work cut out.
